00044 void BiQuad::calcCoeff () {
00045     if (m_type == Pandora::LOWPASS) {
00046         double c = 1.0 / tan (M_PI * m_cutoff / m_info->samplingRate ());
00047         m_a0 = 1.0 / ( 1.0 + m_quality * c + c * c);
00048         m_a1 = 2 * m_a0;
00049         m_a2 = m_a0;
00050         m_b1 = 2.0 * ( 1.0 - c * c) * m_a0;
00051         m_b2 = (1.0 - m_quality * c + c * c) * m_a0;
00052     } else {
00053         double c = tan (M_PI * m_cutoff / m_info->samplingRate ());
00054         m_a0 = 1.0 / (1.0 + m_quality * c + c * c);
00055         m_a1 = -2 * m_a0;
00056         m_a2 = m_a0;
00057         m_b1 = 2.0 * ( c * c - 1.0) * m_a0;
00058         m_b2 = (1.0 - m_quality * c + c * c) * m_a0;
00059     }
00060 }
